title: Peruvian Skillet with Juicy Chicken and Burrata
description: Savor the flavors of Peru in this vibrant skillet dish, loaded with juicy chicken, creamy burrata, and a hint of spice.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the Peruvian pepper to the skillet and cook until slightly charred, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the onion to the skillet and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir in the salt and black pepper.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the chicken for 2-3 minutes.
Crack the burrata cheese into the skillet and stir until creamy and melted.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve the chicken and sauce hot, garnished with chopped cilantro.
